rationale: normalizeHostProps hoists style and className into flat visual props, so a render that carries no style source returns props in which background, border and text colour are ABSENT rather than removed. The removal walk read that absence as an author deletion and hard-reset the element -- transparent background, zero border width, empty text colour -- so an element could lose its fill, border and text in a single frame while merely being hovered. The fix stamps a non-enumerable marker on derived prop sets and skips the destructive reset of derived visual keys when the two sets came from different shapes; an author-removed style, where both sides are flattened, still resets, so the conditional-spread contract is unchanged. render-assets-and-backends is crossed by packages/pulp-react only, plus a versioning.json entry so the SDK surface actually sees the change. No renderer, backend, font, asset or Skia pin changes; no fixture, snapshot or threshold moves. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
